notFound: No existing public draft-to-review function accepting expected full JSON in a request body.

options.name: Complete draft JSON equality filter
options.semantics: Atomic complete JSON equality guard plus identity/status/lifecycle predicates.
options.qualification: URLs measured39,840–40,952 characters before additional predicates. A positive HEAD/count probe proves that read transport/parse works, not a mutation or permanent gateway guarantee.

options.name: Observed xmin row-version guard
options.semantics: Read one exact target with full document/lifecycle plus xmin; validate all fields; PATCH only that exact PK/draft row with xmin equal to the observed row-version transaction ID and lifecycle/identity predicates.
options.qualification: Each UPDATE creates a new row version with xmin. This can reject any intervening row update if exposed by this PostgREST deployment. Confirm with bounded read-only select/filter probe; assert returned version shape; use fresh version for immediate CAS, not as a permanent/global identity. Full document/lifecycle readbacks and existing full review-spec promotion CAS remain required.

options.name: Serialized compact review guard and strict promotion CAS
options.status: Qualified fallback only if transport/system-column approaches fail; parent explicitly permits considering it
options.semantics: Exact complete pre-read, compact atomic draft/status/empty-review/canonical/lifecycle/identity predicates, exact complete post-read, frozen review archive, then existing full reviewed-spec CAS promotion under an exclusive operator window.
options.qualification: Not full draft-document or full catalog atomic CAS. Does not prove an unguarded evidence edit was not overwritten between the review pre-read and PATCH. The one-owner/serialized writer condition must be stated, later drift rejected, and no stronger race guarantee claimed.

unsupportedShortcuts: Do not assume If-Match/ETag is implemented; primary feature issue remains open.
Body-based RPC parameters require an exposed database function; ordinary PATCH body data does not substitute for URL equality filters.
Do not use inserts/upserts, temporary content truncation, admin SQL, pg_catalog function exposure, or a schema change as a workaround.

sources.title: PostgreSQL system columns
sources.supports: xmin identifies the inserting transaction of a row version; each update creates a new version. Transaction IDs are not unique long term.

sources.title: PostgREST Tables and Views
sources.supports: Table row filters are URL query predicates; updates use PATCH.

sources.title: PostgREST Functions as RPC
sources.supports: Named JSON body parameters are arguments to exposed database functions.

sources.title: PostgREST Implement ETag issue1176
sources.supports: General automatic ETag/If-Match cannot be assumed from the documented table API; feature remains an open issue.
